content: Request for DU-Net Figure 4a MovieLens reproduction details

Dear authors,

I am trying to reproduce the DU-Net MovieLens 100K result reported in Figure 4a of "Network-Enabled Sequential Data Acquisition".

My current reproduction is directionally consistent with the Linear UCB comparison under the best local reward-weighted evaluation, but it is not an exact Figure 4a match:

- Local reward-weighted comparison: DU-Net-style 0.9811 vs MF-centered Linear UCB proxy 1.0018; Linear-minus-DU gap 0.0207.
- This recovers about 79.5% of the Figure 4a visual gap estimate (~0.026), but it remains below an exact reproduction target.
- DU-Net also beats Myopic under the same local proxy: Myopic 1.0021; Myopic-minus-DU gap 0.0210.
- Full conventional RMSE still reverses the ordering: DU-Net-style 1.2102 vs MF-centered Linear UCB proxy 1.2025; Linear-minus-DU gap -0.0077.

Would you be able to share any of the following Figure 4a reproduction materials?

Highest-priority materials:
- Exact Figure 4a w-RMSE definition: Weights, normalization denominator, test mask, clipping, aggregation over seeds/cycles.
- MovieLens split and initialization protocol: Train/test split files, initial observed sets, candidate masks, filtering, seed protocol.
- DU-Net observational entropy and DLS implementation: Entropy estimator, DLS smoothing rule, sigma schedule, network diffusion rule, feature normalization.
- Per-cycle tuning protocol for lambda, sigma_t, p_t: Inner train/acquisition/test construction, tuning grid, loss, tie-breaks, retuning frequency.

Helpful comparator details:
- Linear UCB feature/update protocol: Feature map, alpha schedule, regularization, update frequency, reward transform.

If the full source code or supplement archive cannot be shared, the minimum useful subset would be:

- Exact Figure 4a w-RMSE definition, including weighting, normalization, test mask, clipping, and aggregation.
- MovieLens 100K split files or exact split/preprocessing/seed protocol, including the initial observed set and candidate mask.
- DU-Net backend/config details, including architecture, observational entropy estimator, DLS/network diffusion settings, SVD++ hyperparameters, and per-cycle lambda/sigma_t/p_t tuning.
- Linear UCB feature construction, reward transform, regularization, alpha schedule, and update/update-frequency protocol.

My planned validation after receiving any material is intentionally small:
- If Exact Figure 4a w-RMSE definition recovered: Implement metric as an additional reported metric without replacing existing local metrics; validate by Re-evaluate saved/final predictions if possible; otherwise run seeds 0,1,2 only; promote only if DU-Net-vs-Linear gap improves without making conventional/sigmoid contradictions worse.
- If Author MovieLens split or initial/candidate masks recovered: Create a source-faithful 3-seed config using the recovered masks; validate by Run DU-Net current, MF-centered Linear UCB proxy, and Myopic on seeds 0,1,2; promote only if Primary local/paper metric gap improves by at least 0.005 and no reward collapse occurs.
- If DU-Net entropy/DLS implementation recovered: Add a source-faithful DU-Net candidate beside the frozen current DU-Net; validate by Run seeds 0,1,2 with all Phase 1 metrics reported; promote only if Candidate improves frozen DU-Net by at least 0.005 on the primary metric or materially reduces the remaining paper-target shortfall.
- If Per-cycle lambda/sigma_t/p_t tuning protocol recovered: Replace the proxy adaptive tuner with the recovered protocol; validate by Run 1 seed first, then seeds 0,1,2 only if seed0 does not regress reward-weighted w-RMSE; promote only if 3-seed result improves current DU-Net and preserves reward advantage.
- If Paper Linear UCB protocol recovered: Add source-faithful Linear UCB as appendix comparator; keep existing proxy frozen; validate by Run seeds 0,1,2 against current DU-Net and Myopic; promote only if Comparator change does not mask a DU-Net regression and clarifies the paper gap.

Thank you very much for any guidance or artifacts you can share.
Use this email to request the source-backed trigger; do not run another local proxy sweep while waiting.
